summary: Iter102: kiosk NFC-tag linking feature. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass (1 cross-company test skipped because only the demo company has tenants). Tested lookup with an unknown tag (ID normalized to uppercase alphanumeric), 422 for short IDs, 401/403 without a kiosk token, 404 for an invalid tenant, link then lookup (lowercase works), apartment shape matches /kiosk/apartments, 409 'al gekoppeld aan <name>', replace:true moves the tag (old tenant cleared), admin PUT nfc-card set/409/clear, and GET /api/tenants returns nfc_card_id. Frontend (Anita kiosk token): window.onNfcTag with an unknown tag opens nfc-link-modal with uid 04TEST1234. Search, pick and save go to the Jan Pieterse overview. A lowercase rescan opens the overview directly with no modal. postMessage(JSON string) and the 'apk-nfc-tag' CustomEvent (dashed id) open the overview directly. An unknown tag sent as a postMessage object {type:'NFC', uid} opens the modal. Mobile: kiosk-fab-plus opens the sheet, the kiosk-tile-nfc tile opens the modal in nfc-link-waiting state with save disabled. A scan while the modal is open fills the uid and does NOT navigate the kiosk behind it. Clash flow (tag on Jan, pick Marlies) shows nfc-link-clash, nfc-link-replace moves the tag and opens Marlies' overview. Admin UI: TenantNfcCard shows the value, edit/save normalizes 04adm5678 to 04ADM5678, delete with confirm shows tenant-nfc-empty. All test tags cleaned up (no tenant has nfc_card_id).

minor.issue: No single-tenant GET exists (405). nfc_card_id is only returned via the GET /api/tenants list. That is fine for the UI; just noting it because the review request said 'GET tenant'.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'NFC-tag koppelen' tile is only in the mobile KioskAddSheet (kiosk-fab-plus / kiosk-mobile-fab are md:hidden). The desktop kiosk-bottom-bar has Huurder/Appt./Locatie/Contract/Factuur/Betalingen/Onderhoud/Kasgeld buttons but no NFC button. On kiosk tablets >=768px wide the manual 'NFC-tag koppelen' entry cannot be reached (only the auto-open on an unknown scan works).

issues: When opened from the sheet and an ALREADY-linked tag is scanned, the text still says 'Tag X is nog niet gekoppeld' even though it is linked (the clash only appears on save). Consider a lookup on scan inside the modal so it can show 'gekoppeld aan <name>'.
The modal lists only tenants that have an apartment (it uses /kiosk/apartments), so tenants without an apartment cannot get a tag on the kiosk.
The toast 'Tag gekoppeld aan <name>' is set in onLinked, but toasts only render when step==='select'. onLinked navigates to the overview, so the success toast is never visible.
The new TenantNfcCard 'NFC-TAG' section and the older 'NFC-kaart' button in Acties both manage the same field. That is duplicate UI; consider removing one.

action_items: Add an NFC-tag koppelen button to the desktop/tablet kiosk-bottom-bar (md+), e.g. data-testid kiosk-nfc-btn-desktop, calling setNfcLink({uid:''})
Optional: in NfcLinkModal, look up the scanned tag and show the current link instead of 'nog niet gekoppeld'
Optional: show the 'Tag gekoppeld' toast on the overview step too (or drop it)
Optional: remove the duplicate NFC-kaart action button in TenantDetail
critical_code_review_comments: nfc-bus: the last subscriber wins. This works because NfcLinkModal mounts after the kiosk listener. The kiosk listener re-subscribes only when step changes, which cannot happen while the modal is open, so it is OK.
kiosk_nfc_link replace: the clear and set are two separate update_one calls with no unique index on (company_id, nfc_card_id). Concurrent links could create duplicates; acceptable at kiosk scale.

The tenant QR endpoints (~7190, ~7254) auto-generate nfc_card_id when it is missing. Deleting a tag in admin, then printing a QR plate, silently creates a new random tag ID. Be aware this interacts with the 'remove link' feature.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; desktop entry point missing)

seed_data_creation: Ran setup_iter85.py (Anita reseeded, a TEST_ payment and a TEST_ printer inserted). NFC test tags 04TEST1234/04ADM5678/04PYTEST9911/04PYADM77 were all removed.
